research_basis: CCOHS task-relative standing work heights: precision above elbow, light work slightly below and heavy downward-force work substantially below elbow; owner anthropometry and mock-up still govern
Bott/LISTA industrial benchmarks support 0.75 m depth, approximately 0.84–0.90 m fixed heights and modular heavy-duty construction
Treston electronics benchmarks support 0.80 m depth and 0.70–1.10 m height-adjustable ESD-capable modules
ESD Association guidance requires dissipative worksurface, personnel grounding and a common point bonded to equipment protective earth
HSE solder guidance requires effective source extraction rather than a simple fume-dispersing fan
Real lift manufacturer bay geometry and obstruction clearances govern over the current schematic exclusion envelope
coordination_holds_append: D-079 retains both 9.00 × 0.75 m corner-start wall-bench footprints and divides each into six replaceable 1.50 m modules; the two sides deliberately receive different duty classes, heights, surfaces and services.
The Project Car bench tests five modules at +0.90 m and one lower heavy-force/vice module at +0.84 m. Final heights require owner elbow-height measurement, real tasks and a full-scale mock-up.

The RC wall bench tests three 0.80 m-deep manual-adjustable clean-electronics modules with a +0.70–1.10 m range inside the retained 0.75 m building datum; fixed model-mechanics, tools and landing modules remain at +0.90 m.

Only the clean RC electronics modules receive an ESD worksurface and common-point ground bonded to protective earth. The soldering module requires effective source extraction. LiPo charging remains a separate noncombustible, ventilated and professionally assessed station.
The central RC island remains 4.50 × 1.60 m, is divided into three 1.50 m modules and tests a +0.84 m top for large-object assembly from both sides. Fixed versus lockable-mobile support remains open.
The 1.20 m Project Car bench operating strip overlaps the schematic lift/vehicle envelope by 1.10 m. This is an explicit product-selection and simultaneous-use conflict, not a passed clearance.

The 3D-printer and LiPo support-equipment envelopes move 0.40 m inward in the RC bay so the 1.20 m wall-bench operating strip remains graphically clear. Extraction, battery fire strategy and real equipment still govern.

Wall-bench tops remain structurally and environmentally independent of the +0.90 m technical-window sill. Detail a removable rear service zone, maintainable shadow gap, drainage and seals without loading window frames or facade girts.
